pending_gate.summary: Root cause for shop-web: ProductList maps category objects into chips but uses the object itself as React key and setCategory value, so keys collide as [object Object] and fetchProducts sends category=[object Object]. Proposed fix (fence: ProductList.jsx only): use c.name (All stays "") for key, active state, and setCategory; keep chipLabel on the object. shop-api uniform (8) counts stay out of this fence.

Analysis for shop-api: GET /api/categories returns {name,count} but count is (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM products) for every row, so every chip shows the catalogue total (8). Scope fence: fix the categories SQL in server.js so count is per-category. Paired shop-web story covers the [object Object] key/filter bug.
